blocks.description: On the left, the program with three capabilities: Console, FileCap and Clock. On the right, the host with the terminal, the disk and the time. Each capability is an arrow to its resource.

caption.text: The program does not touch the host directly: every resource is used through its key, which the host handed over when asked.
